title: Kissed Juicy Jamaican Pork Skewers
description: A light and juicy Jamaican dish featuring Appleton rum and shio-koji-cure, perfect for a satvik-friendly meal. The fermentation process gives the pork a unique and delicious flavor.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together Appleton rum, shio-koji, brown sugar, soy sauce, lime juice, scallions, thyme, and cayenne pepper to make the marinade.
Add the pork cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight to allow the pork to ferment.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pork is cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional scallions and thyme if desired.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as grilled vegetables or coconut rice.
